Two indexed local pictures materially clarify those domains and composition orders without requiring an arbitrary Jordan type or a misleading generic-length chain. Existing proof completeness does not remove this explanatory value.

diagram_math_checks.justification: These are precisely the equations cutting out Z in the Statement, not equality of A_i B_i with B_i A_i. The reverse arrows display the two backtracking paths; adjacent prose specifies their equality and the boundary relation.

diagram_math_checks.objects_and_maps: The second picture repeats U_t at both ends; B_{t-1}:U_t->U_{t-1}, then A_{t-1}:U_{t-1}->U_t. The curved arrow theta has domain and codomain U_t.

diagram_math_checks.justification: Statement lines 55-56 defines this end map, used in proof 1.2 and 9.1. Thus the terminal triangle commutes. Repeating U_t denotes the same vector space, not an additional chain vertex.

diagram_math_checks.range_checks: Interior picture requires 2 <= i < t and hence t >= 3. The terminal picture requires t >= 2. No arrows or equations are asserted for t=0 or t=1.
